title: Machine Learning & NLP Basics I Learned at AIUB
description:
Natural Language Processing always fascinated me because human language is messy, nuanced, and full of ambiguity. In our AI & Data Science coursework at AIUB, I transitioned from theoretical math to building hands-on predictive models with Python, Pandas, and Scikit-Learn.

My first text classification project explored sentiment and topic detection using TF-IDF (Term Frequency - Inverse Document Frequency) paired with Naive Bayes and Logistic Regression. Learning to clean raw text—tokenization, stopword removal, and lemmatization—revealed that 80% of data science success depends on thoughtful data preprocessing.

Evaluating models using Confusion Matrices, Precision, Recall, and F1-Scores rather than just raw accuracy was an eye-opener. It showed me how models behave when classes are imbalanced and gave me a solid foundation for exploring modern LLMs and Transformers.

title: eFootball Tournament 2025
description:
My Experience as an eFootball Volunteer

Being part of the eFootball Tournament 2025, organized by Connect eSports, the official esports wing of AIUB Connect, was a valuable and rewarding experience for me. Held from October 9 to October 31, 2025, the tournament brought together 110+ registered players and highlighted the growing esports culture at our university.

My Role & Responsibilities
As an eFootball Volunteer, I was responsible for managing 3 groups, with 16 players in each group. My responsibilities included coordinating players, maintaining effective communication, and helping ensure fair play and smooth tournament operations.

Working closely with players and the organizing team helped me develop practical skills in event management, team coordination, communication, and leadership.

Key Takeaways
This experience taught me the importance of teamwork, responsibility, and clear communication in managing a large-scale event. It also strengthened my interest in esports and community-driven initiatives.
I am grateful to Team AIUB Connect, Connect eSports, fellow volunteers, organizers, and players for making this journey meaningful. I look forward to taking part in more initiatives where I can contribute, learn, and grow professionally.

Event: eFootball Tournament 2025
Organizer: Connect eSports — AIUB Connect
Role: eFootball Volunteer
Duration: October 9–31, 2025

title: 100-Day GitHub Contribution Challenge
description:
Completing My 100-Day GitHub Contribution Challenge 

I'm excited to share that I successfully completed a 100-day streak of GitHub contributions, maintaining consistency and contributing every single day from August 9 to November 16, 2025.

This challenge was more than just maintaining a streak. It helped me develop discipline, strengthen my problem-solving habits, and stay committed to continuous learning and technical growth.

Key Highlights
Total Contributions: 506
Longest Streak: 100 consecutive days
Challenge Period: August 9 – November 16, 2025
Most Used Languages: C# (34.70%), Java (27.54%), C++ (17.87%)

Throughout this journey, I learned the value of showing up consistently, making steady progress, and improving through practice.

I'm grateful for the support and motivation from the developer community. This milestone is another step forward in my journey as a developer, and I'm looking forward to building more projects and taking on new challenges.
